messages:
maya: Cutting the release window in ~2h for v2.9.0. Quick sanity check: can everyone confirm a green sweep on main/release branches and call out any flaky signals?

ci-bot: [CI] queued pipeline for branch release/v2.9.0 — workflow: release/smoke-suite (run id: 1862357895)

jonah: running a local smoke now. will push a green if nothing obvious within 15m :clock15:

liam: I saw intermittent failure in integration-test::session-timeout yesterday (2 failures in 24h). I filed a flaky ticket #FLAKY-412 but not blocked.

maya: thanks @liam — do we have a quick mitigation? can we mute the test for this cutoff or add a retry?

liam: quickest is to add a 1-flaky-retry in CI for that job. i'll post the patch in a min.

release-coordinator: heads up — if we add retries, note unit-cost impact. ops wants to avoid increasing pipeline time beyond 20%.

jonah: current smoke run: all unit/integration quick checks green except the known session-timeout flake (skipped locally to validate other failures). Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/1862357895 :thumbsup:

ci-bot: [CI] release/smoke-suite step "integration" failed (job: integration-test::session-timeout) — logs: https://ci.internal/logs/1862357895/integration

liam: patch uploaded: add `retry: 1` to integration matrices for the cutoff. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release/patches/421 — short description in PR body.

maya: @jonah can you re-trigger a green sweep with that retry in place? i'll sign off if the rest is clean.

jonah: re-triggered with patch merged to release/v2.9.0 — build id 1862358911.

srebot: [Alert] Observability: increased 95p latency on model-proxy in us-west-2 during earlier tests, correlated with heavy batching in staging. Not blocking but FYI.

liam: noted. that latency spike is expected with the load pattern but didn't affect correctness. I'll add a note to the release notes under "known infra quirks".

ci-bot: [CI] build 1862358911 — all smoke checks passed. artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1862358911

maya: great. one more thing — changelog nudges: please verify your component entries in CHANGELOG.md. Small wording fixes only; no feature moves.

release-coordinator: reminder: cutoff is at 18:00 UTC. if anyone needs an exception, post here with rationale.

jonah: changing a minor doc string in core-serve — will not change behavior. adding entry now.

liam: I'm good, just the flake note.

maya: ok team — looks green enough for cutoff. I'll proceed with the tag and release prep in ~10m. thanks everyone :party-parrot:

ci-bot: [CI] tag created: v2.9.0 (1862360300)

maya: tagging complete. follow-up: please monitor post-release dashboards and escalate any regressions to #incidents.

release-coordinator: copy that. posting a quick rollout announcement in #announcements in 5m.

jonah: thanks all, nice coordinated sweep.

liam: good job — will follow up on flaky ticket next week.

maya: closing this thread after release — will reopen if any post-cutoff issues.
